name: Subject Pronouns
summary: Subject pronouns: words that replace nouns as the subject of a sentence.
explanation: Subject pronouns are used instead of a noun when we don't want to repeat it. In English, there are 7 subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. They are divided into singular and plural.

form_notes.singular: Singular pronouns: I (speaker), you (one person you speak to), he (one male), she (one female), it (one thing or animal).
form_notes.plural: Plural pronouns: we (speaker and others), you (more than one person), they (other people or things).

common_error_explanations.err_01: «Him» is an object pronoun, not a subject pronoun. Use «he» as the subject.
common_error_explanations.err_02: «Me» is an object pronoun, not a subject pronoun. Use «I» as the subject.
